skills.name: using-agent-skills
skills.reason: Useful intent-to-skill mapping, but a second active router would conflict with Factory selective routing.

skills.name: interview-me
skills.reason: Keep uncertainty elicitation; remove mandatory questioning and pseudo-precise confidence thresholds.

skills.name: idea-refine
skills.reason: Strong product discovery lenses; load only for ideation/product discovery.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.reason: Strong capability/spec gates; approvals become risk-based rather than mandatory at every phase.

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.reason: Adopt dependency, acceptance and verification structure; treat size limits as heuristics.

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.reason: Adopt small reversible slices; distinguish workspace checkpoints from git commits.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.reason: Keep Prove-It regression pattern; test strategy is risk/behavior driven, not universal fixed ratios.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.reason: Excellent context budgeting, progressive disclosure and durable/transient separation.

skills.name: source-driven-development
skills.reason: Primary-source/version-first workflow directly strengthens Truth and Engineering.

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.reason: Use as high-risk independent verifier, not an always-on token-expensive loop.

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.reason: Useful state/responsive/accessibility patterns; update WCAG baseline and remove stack-specific dogma.

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.reason: Strong contract/idempotency/backward-compatibility guidance; policy varies by public/internal boundary.

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.reason: Runtime evidence is valuable; tool/MCP details remain adapter-specific and permission-bounded.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.reason: Reproduce/localize/reduce/root-cause/guard workflow is broadly reusable.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.reason: Five-axis review and severity are strong; numeric diff/file thresholds remain heuristics.

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.reason: Behavior-preserving simplification and Chesterton's Fence are useful; no magic line-count gates.

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.reason: Strong trust-boundary and supply-chain guidance; web taxonomy updated to OWASP Top 10 2025.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.reason: Measure-first and re-measure discipline adopted; budgets are project-specific except external standards.

skills.name: git-workflow-and-versioning
skills.reason: Atomic/reversible history is useful; branching/squash conventions are project policy, not universal law.

skills.name: ci-cd-and-automation
skills.reason: Adopt automated gates and rollback concepts; detect actual runtime/CI stack before generating commands.

skills.name: deprecation-and-migration
skills.reason: Adopt expand/migrate/contract; require recoverability rather than a fake down migration for every change.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.reason: Decision rationale and current-state documentation strengthen durable Factory memory.

skills.name: observability-and-instrumentation
skills.reason: Question-first telemetry, structured logs, RED/USE and verification are production-grade.

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.reason: Staged rollout/rollback is strong; rollout percentages and waiting windows are risk-configurable policies.

skillAnatomy.notes: Keep discovery metadata, progressive disclosure, evidence-based verification and eval requirement; size limits and bash-only helpers are not invariants.

evalFramework.notes: Retain structural, routing and behavioral layers; add semantic, adversarial, cross-model and production-regression tiers.

accessibilityReference.notes: 44x44 remains a Factory UX target where practical, not a statement of WCAG AA minimum.

securityReference.notes: Package-manager/version matrices are volatile references and must be verified from current official docs.

performanceReference.notes: Core Web Vitals standards may be referenced; bundle/API/font budgets are project-specific heuristics.

setupGuides.notes: Codex/Gemini/Cursor/Copilot/Windsurf/OpenCode/Antigravity/CommandCode setup guidance is high-volatility and must not become evergreen core knowledge.

windsurfSetup.notes: Prefer current native skills/rules surfaces instead of a .windsurfrules-centric model.

opencodeSetup.notes: Current OpenCode has native skill discovery; AGENTS.md remains project policy rather than the skill transport itself.

sddCacheHook.notes: Cache normalized/raw source with validators and content hash; do not cache one prompt-shaped interpretation keyed only by URL.

simplifyIgnoreHook.notes: Protect ranges through write-policy/patch validation; never mutate real source to placeholders and depend on a stop hook for restoration.

personas.notes: Retain role lens + fixed output contract; do not create a second management hierarchy or persona-calls-persona tree.
